attributes.board_name: Idaho Board of Psychologist Examiners (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.accepted_credit_types: No pre-approval list; CE must be at an appropriate professional level in psychology, licensee demonstrates relevance
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed individuals are considered compliant for the remainder of the year in which the license is granted.
rules.audit_note: Keep personal CE records 3 years; random audits may be conducted.
rules.notes: 30 h every two calendar years, incl. 4 h in Laws and Ethics. DOPL is moving this board to biennial licensure from July 1, 2025 (renewal dates vary during transition).
30 h of psychopharmacotherapy CE every two calendar years, in addition to the 30 h required to renew the psychologist license.
